name: Florianópolis Portuguese (manezinho)
notes: The traditional speech of native Florianópolis, the 'manezinho' or 'ilhéu' variety of the island of Santa Catarina. Two features set it apart from the pt-BR base. Coda /S/ is palato-alveolar [ʃ ʒ]: Brescancini (2015: 82) finds 'a variante palato-alveolar como predominante na amostra [...] em 83% das ocorrências'. /t d/ stay stops before [i]: 'Uma das características mais evidentes no falar "manezinho" é ausência da africação de /t,d/' (Dias 2010: 2). The stops describe native speakers: the ALiB rates palatalisation in the capital as 'moderada' (Battisti & Dornelles Filho 2015: 226), because the city has many migrants (Dias 2010: 2). Everything else is inherited from pt-BR.

DISABLED: /d/ stays a stop before [i]; see the positional before_i map.

Coda /S/ is palato-alveolar [ʃ] before a voiceless consonant and word-finally (festa, mas). Brescancini (2015: 82): 'a variante palato-alveolar como predominante na amostra [...] em 83% das ocorrências'.
Voiced counterpart of FLORIPA_CODA_S: a coda /z/ before a voiced consonant surfaces as [ʒ] (Brescancini 2015: 82).

The palatal coda /S/ takes the voicing of a following voiced consonant: mesmo [ˈmeʒmu], desde [ˈdeʒdi], Lisboa [liʒˈboɐ]. Brescancini (2015: 76): '[s] ou [S] antes de consoante surda ou pausa e [z] ou [Z] antes de consoante sonora' (fe[S]ta, me[Z]mo). The rule runs in the second pass, after FLORIPA_CODA_S has written the coda as [ʃ].
